about: Bespoke recipes for every special area in pokedex.json. Read by pokeroutes/areas (poke-routes). Coordinates are [dy, dx] from the area centre; stamps are documented in 'stamps'.

schema.species: dex species the area belongs to
schema.kind: inline (stamped into the route) | submap (separate map behind an entrance)
schema.context: terrain the area needs around it (see pokeroutes/areas/contexts.py)
schema.biomes: route biomes it may appear in
schema.approach_footprint: [w, h] of the route-side entrance area (submaps)
schema.visibility: hidden | glimpse | visible from a lane
schema.door: auto | n | s | e | w: which side the way in faces
schema.activity: what the Pokemon are doing here
schema.ecology: why they are here: the believable reason
schema.fix: what was changed vs the dex, if anything
schema.dex_habitats: corrected habitats written back to pokedex.json (only when changed)
schema.approach: compose for the route side of a submap
schema.mons: [{species, at: [dy,dx] | anchor, n, move, spread, on, lead, unique, text}]
schema.on_enter: {text, cry}: once-per-visit trigger at the way in
schema.interior: submap: {type, size, compose, mons, interact, suffix}
schema.encounters: [[species, weight]] wild table for the area's grass
schema.story: one-paragraph description for the UI and books

moves: wander | wander_far | wander_slow | look_around | sleep | pace_h | pace_v | circle | spin | face[:dir] | spar[:dir] | walk_in_place[:dir] | tree_disguise | rock_disguise | buried | hidden

stamps.clearing: Open ground: the floor of the area.
stamps.fill: A literal rectangle of one class, centred on (y, x).
stamps.thicket: A clump of trees (blocking), e.g. to close a side or make a hollow.
stamps.tree_wall: A ring of trees around a clearing with gaps (the only ways in).
stamps.tall_grass: Encounter grass (and, beside water, a reed bed).
stamps.reeds: Tall grass hugging every water edge within r: a reed bed.
stamps.rock_rise: A blocking mass of rock: an outcrop or the shoulder of a rise.
stamps.rock_ring: Boulders/rock mounds set around (y, x): a rocky rise with a way up.
stamps.boulders: A scatter of loose boulders on open ground.
stamps.mound: One 2x2 rock mound with its top-left at (y, x).
stamps.great_tree: A single broad old tree (2x2) standing apart; (y, x) is its bottom-left trunk cell.
stamps.bare_ring: Ground where nothing grows: scorched, trampled, salted. Bare earth (p) or ash (v);
stamps.worn_ring: A trodden circle: a ring path (wrestling ring, dancing ground, sundial).
stamps.pale_patch: Pale trodden grass (General 9-slice): a lawn, a sunning patch, a dancing floor.
stamps.fence_pen: A wooden pen (Route 117 fence) with a gate gap on one side.
stamps.standing_stones: Grey stones set in a ring: shrine stones, a court, a cairn circle.
stamps.ruin_wall: A tumbled line of grey stone (the foundation of a wall), with gaps.
stamps.ruin_room: The footprint of a ruined building: a rectangle of tumbled stone around a bare floor.
stamps.cliff: A cliff face along one side of the footprint (the wall the area backs onto).
stamps.cave_mouth: A rock face with a cave mouth; (y, x) is the door cell. Also a sub-map entrance.
stamps.rock_hollow: A big rock with a dark hollow at its foot (Fortree). (y, x) is the hollow.
stamps.tree_door: A huge trunk with a door in it (Fortree tree house). (y, x) is the door.
stamps.split_oak: A great oak split by lightning, 4x5 (custom tiles). (y, x) = the cleft at its foot.
stamps.fallen_log: A huge fallen trunk lying east-west, 5x2 (custom tiles). (y, x) = its middle top.
stamps.object: An object-event prop: breakable_rock, cuttable_tree, pushable_boulder.
stamps.burrows: Single-cell bare patches dotted over grass: burrow mouths and spoil heaps.
stamps.path: A straight-ish trodden path from (y, x) to centre+to.
stamps.prop: A purely descriptive prop for the scene viewer (no tile change).
